name: Visit Qatar
verdict: Visit Qatar is the Qatari state's tourism body and became a principal partner of the (Audi) F1 team for 2026.
note: Rating note: Partnership: Qatar Tourism press release, 2025-11-29 (https://www.qatartourism.com/en/news-and-media/press-releases/visit-qatar-announces-principal-partnership-with-the-future-audi) and Audi press release of the same date.

why.text: Visit Qatar is the Qatari state’s tourism body. Amnesty International reports that migrant workers in Qatar are still exposed to exploitation despite reforms, and that expression and assembly are tightly restricted. A tourism brand on a famous team makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: Amnesty International reports that migrant workers in Qatar are still exposed to exploitation.
